claims: C1 the Model Spec includes root-level rules
C2 the Model Spec includes user-level defaults
C3 the Model Spec includes guideline-level defaults
C4 user-level and guideline-level defaults can be overridden by users or developers
C5 these defaults are helpful in many cases but do not work for all users and contexts

concepts.name: root_level_rule
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the Model Spec that operates at the root level

concepts.name: user_level_default
concepts.gloss: D is a default in the Model Spec that operates at the user level

concepts.name: guideline_level_default
concepts.gloss: D is a default in the Model Spec that operates at the guideline level

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: the ranking of instruction authority levels: root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts

asserts.read_back: overriding % is permitted because it is a user-level default
overriding % is permitted because it is a guideline-level default

closure.reason: the clause permits overriding user-level and guideline-level defaults only; overriding root-level rules or other entities is not addressed by this clause and not permitted
